description: This Java interface defines a repository for EntityViewEntity objects, providing various database query methods for retrieving, searching, and managing entity view data within the Thingsboard platform. It includes custom queries for fetching entity view info, filtering by tenant, type, customer, and relations, as well as methods for checking existence and batch processing.

classes.name: EntityViewRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for EntityViewEntity, providing methods for querying entity views with various filters and relations.

methods.name: findEntityViewInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about an entity view by its ID, including related customer info.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds entity views by tenant ID with optional text search, returning a paginated result.

methods.name: findEntityViewInfosByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves entity view info objects for a tenant, with optional text search, paginated.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds entity views by tenant ID and type, with optional text search, paginated.

methods.name: findEntityViewInfosByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info for entity views filtered by tenant ID and type, with optional text search.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds entity views by tenant and customer IDs, with optional text search, paginated.

methods.name: findEntityViewInfosByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info for entity views filtered by tenant and customer IDs, with optional text search.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndType
methods.description: Finds entity views by tenant, customer, and type, with optional text search.

methods.name: findEntityViewInfosByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndType
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info for entity views filtered by tenant, customer, and type.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds an entity view by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findEntityInfosByNamePrefix
methods.description: Finds entity info objects with names starting with a given prefix.

methods.name: findAllByTenantIdAndEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves all entity views for a tenant and specific entity ID.

methods.name: existsByTenantIdAndEntityId
methods.description: Checks if an entity view exists for a given tenant and entity ID.

methods.name: findEntityViewsByTenantIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Finds entity views by tenant ID and a list of entity view IDs.

methods.name: findTenantEntityViewTypes
methods.description: Retrieves distinct types of entity views for a tenant.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEdgeId
methods.description: Finds entity views related to a specific edge ID, with optional text search.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEdgeIdAndType
methods.description: Finds entity views related to a specific edge ID and type, with optional text search.

methods.name: getExternalIdById
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for an entity view by its ID.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of EntityViewFields after a given ID, limited by specified size.
